help: write an explicit fixed-arity annotation such as `tuple[int, int]`
message: the `...` type argument in `tuple[...]` is not supported yet -- a homogeneous-variadic container has no compile-time length, so write an explicit fixed-arity annotation such as `tuple[int, int]` instead
